construct.claim: A total computable generator of counterexamples with witnesses for all clocked polynomial programs exists iff P!=NP; for linear clocks such a generator exists unconditionally but necessarily takes exponential time along a self-description family.
construct.scope: Actual same-U general program descriptions and output convention; external binary clocks on individual programs for discovery analysis; original U stages unchanged.
construct.derivation: Enumerate failures; linear domain follows from prior unbounded quadratic failures; reconstruct own description from literal source and binary h, run generator on clock 2^h and emit supplied witness; charge polynomial simulation and explicit output.
unresolved_steps: Unconditional unbounded cubic-stage failure or uniform polynomial cutoff.
candidate_tests: Exact finite linear-clock witness failure and writer output/timeout convention; binary clock tuple encoding.

alternative.claim: Total unclocked witnessed discovery on all valid codes cannot defeat every polynomial-time program; no single polynomial witnessed-list generator supplies same-U bad instances at exponents tending to infinity.
alternative.scope: Actual same-U general program descriptions and output convention; external binary clocks on individual programs for discovery analysis; original U stages unchanged.
alternative.derivation: Fixed self-description in the unclocked case; fixed list-recomputing program dominates its own generated witnesses at some stage exponent.
unresolved_steps: A resource-preserving existence argument or formula-only adversary at unbounded cubic stage.
